what_this_proves: The four defects production actually had are closed on BOTH halves, and the seam they came through has guards that read the other side's source instead of restating their own.

red_first.file_search: The device fix was reverted from a sha256-verified backup copy and FileSearchRootsContractTests re-run: 3 failed / 6 passed. Restored and verified by digest; the suite then passed 9/9.
red_first.why_it_matters: Without this the tests would only show that the new code agrees with itself.

observed_in_ci.device_tests: PagentOS.Agent.Tests.dll Passed 881 / Skipped 6 / Total 887 - up from 869 before this batch (+18: FileSearchRootsContractTests 9, AppManifestContractTests 5, DeviceProtocolSchemaContractTests 4)

new_shared_contracts: packages/protocol/file-search-roots.json - the bucket names file.search accepts; the device resolves and then CONFINES them, so a bucket is never more authority than a path
packages/protocol/app-manifest.example.json - the manifest the App Factory sends, in both its shapes (a server, and a project that binds nothing)
device_changes: WellKnownFolders.cs - a roots entry may be an absolute path, a bucket name, or a bucket with relative segments; everything still goes through AuthorisedRoots.Confine
ProjectManifest.cs - port 0 means 'binds nothing' in ANY scope, not only 3D/native
ProjectCapabilities.cs - a project that declares no port is RUN as a batch rather than waited for on a socket
found_on_the_way: Python's default casing is not Turkish: "Indirilenler" with a dotted capital lowercases to 'i' plus U+0307, which matched no alias key - so a folder typed the ordinary Turkish way was refused as unknown. Folded properly now, with I/i/dotless forms all accepted for this closed vocabulary.

Three more fakes were smaller than the device (project.test without counts_parsed, one also without duration_ms). test_device_fakes_match_the_device now reads the keys from ProjectCapabilities.cs itself.
The device protocol schema, carried over from B02, now holds its C# half: HelloMessage's wire names are compared with the schema's own $defs.hello.
proof: PROVEN_AUTOMATED for all fourteen. PROVEN_REAL needs a production release (roadmap decision 0, owner-gated).
